limitations: OCR sampling covers every retained clip start/end plus periodic interiors; it is not exhaustive recognition of every pixel in every video frame.
Known static exposure locations and transition masks were visually reviewed. Final media hashes stayed unchanged throughout review.
Manual keyboard fallback remains unconfirmed. No new product-bug count is established.
Native 150% detail crop preserves original timing, including the banner shown after the popup disappears.

factual_caveats: Settled refreshed sort is default descending with the ascending indicator cleared.
Final unfiltered inventory shows All 7, Active 0, Inactive 7.
Desktop D-Bus error is an environment limitation.

limitations: Genuine foreground desktop footage at original elapsed speed. No generated, reconstructed, or recreated UI; opaque crops/masks and editorial captions only.

The source has 27,892 stored frames over 1,396 seconds. Seventeen adjacent timestamp steps exceed 50 ms; maximum step is 300 ms. CFR 20 fps duplicate-holds bridge these short source gaps without time compression.
Periodic and scene-triggered OCR plus independent visual checks are sampling-based, not every-pixel certification. Full decode was checked for every final MP4.
UTC labels describe recording time. Event-row clocks are UI display values and are not independently verified UTC receipt times.
Idle foreground waits and the native XFCE D-Bus error remain in the archive; visible continuity does not imply continuous active testing.
The 150% popup is visible near the beginning of the two-second detail crop, then disappears naturally. The 125% popup detail crop lasts one second. Remaining UI clips retain their native pixel scale.

The draft was discarded without Add to Session, Ctrl+Enter, new logpoints, or reactivation. Manual-entry keyboard fallback remains UNCONFIRMED; no broad keyboard-inaccessibility or keyboard-trap claim is made.
The line field is discoverable by the meaningful accessible name Enter line number (exact role lookup count 1). Absent explicit ARIA/label attributes alone are not an unlabeled-field defect.
Native Alt+F1 produced an XFCE D-Bus error. This environment/tool limitation is not scored as a Datadog defect.
Settled sampled ascending rows are chronological. Refresh removes the ascending indicator and returns default descending rows; no persistence contract or new finding is asserted.
The alternate draft cleared Environment. The Environment selector showed No environments found when searched for staging; no cause is established. The service was stopped during the observation.
Existing ten findings and original case counts remain unchanged. Final unfiltered inventory is All 7 / Active 0 / Inactive 7 at 100% zoom.
publication: External publication was not performed by the sanitation workflow.
